nodes.title: Owner directive: users are India-only, so production moves to Azure South India (Chennai): Foundry/Speech, Container Apps, and Azure PostgreSQL Flexible in the same region replacing Neon prod (Neon kept as rollback and for test branches). Central India rejected: its Foundry catalogue has 20 models, none we use. Image generation and gpt-4o-mini-tts stay in eastus2 (not offered in South India; nothing waits on them live). Reverse if measured India-side turn latency does not improve, or South India quota cannot carry the live lanes.
